query: M-0001: Recurring stage temperature errors and overlay correction warnings since yesterday.

tool_definitions.description: Search historical diagnostic cases by symptom and suspected subsystem. Returns HC- identifiers, symptoms, confirmed failure modes and resolutions. Compare relevant cases with current machine evidence; cite returned HC- refs only when they support the diagnosis.
tool_definitions.name: azure_ai_search

query.description:
The text query to use for vector search. 
The query should be a string that describes the information you are looking for. For example, 'Azure TV reset instructions'

tool_definitions.description:
List a machine's error events in a look-back window: a per-code summary (count, first
and last seen) plus the individual events. Each event has a ref (EV-...) to cite.
tool_definitions.name: diagnostics___get_error_events

include_info.description: Include informational events such as lot start/complete. Default false.

tool_definitions.description:
List a machine's service logbook entries (maintenance, interventions, observations) in a
look-back window. Each entry has a ref (LB-...) to cite.
tool_definitions.name: diagnostics___get_logbook

tool_definitions.description:
Get a machine's configuration (platform, site, software release and date of the last
software update), the current reference time, and the telemetry signals available for it
with their nominal values and tolerances.
tool_definitions.name: diagnostics___get_machine_context

tool_definitions.description:
Summarize one telemetry signal over a look-back window: baseline vs recent mean, recent
standard deviation, min/max, linear trend per day, count and first time of readings outside
tolerance, and downsampled samples. Cite it by its ref (TS:<machine>:<signal>).
tool_definitions.name: diagnostics___get_telemetry_window

sample_every_hours.description: Spacing of the returned samples in hours (1-24). Default 6.

signal.description: Signal name as listed by get_machine_context.

tool_definitions.description:
Look up an error code in the diagnostic reference: description, severity, subsystem and
the failure modes known to raise it, with recommended checks. Several failure modes can
share a code, so use telemetry and logbook evidence to discriminate between them.
tool_definitions.name: diagnostics___lookup_error_code

confirming_checks: Verify stage cooling loop flow rate against specification.
Inspect cooling loop valves and filters touched during the last maintenance.
